recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the narrative half of the Published FHIR-20849 decision without broadening into other StructureMap mapping-language backlog items.
issue_request: FHIR-20849 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-I and requested making StructureMap.group.rule.name optional plus updating the mapping-language description so it no longer implied every rule needs a persisted or parser-generated name.
initial_application: The original implementation commit f7e617e576302162ba6b96f6ddfede11a02e820a, merged by 7c6b62dae230fa69a9a5cb9559de751244e4b036, changed the StructureMap spreadsheet cardinality for StructureMap.group.rule.name from 1..1 to 0..1. Current source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml has min=0, but source/mapping-language.html still retained the Jira-quoted generated-name wording.
additional_context: StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini and source/mapping-language.html is listed in source/hierarchy.xml. The formal mapping grammar already has ruleName optional. Zulip evidence showed implementation coordination for PR #978 and later backlog discussion; Confluence had no FHIR-20849 references, and no community evidence was found that reversed the Jira decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/mapping-language.html to mark the trailing quoted rule name optional in the rule format and to state that rule names are optional, author-supplied names must be unique, and engines may assign internal generated names only when they need to identify unnamed rules.
source_changes: source/mapping-language.html: marked the trailing quoted transform-rule name as optional and replaced ambiguous generated-name prose with explicit optional-name guidance.
